cond_0001.intro: We are looking for an experienced Cyber Security Analyst to join our team at [Company name masked]. In this role you will be responsible for safeguarding the organization's information systems, networks, and data from cyber threats and security breaches, while maintaining a secure environment that aligns with industry best practices and regulatory requirements.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
In this role you will:
Monitor network and system logs, security alerts, and other sources of potential threats. Detect and analyze security incidents promptly and coordinate with relevant teams to implement appropriate incident response procedures. Conduct regular assessments of our systems and networks to identify potential weaknesses and security gaps. Collaborate with the IT team to prioritize and address vulnerabilities effectively. Maintain and manage various security tools and technologies, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, antivirus, and encryption systems, to ensure continuous protection against cyber threats. Assist in developing, updating, and implementing security policies, standards, and procedures to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards. Lead security awareness training sessions for employees, educating them about standard processes and potential security risks, to create a security-conscious culture within the organization. Conduct in-depth analysis of security incidents to identify the root cause, extent of impact, and potential remediation strategies to prevent future occurrences. Stay up-to-date with the latest cyber threats, hacking techniques, and security trends. Analyze threat intelligence reports and incorporate relevant findings into the organization's security measures. Collaborate with internal and external auditors to support security audits, assessments, and compliance reviews. Address any identified issues and assist in implementing corrective actions. Generate regular reports on security incidents, threat landscapes, and overall security posture. Present findings to management and provide recommendations for continuous improvement. Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, a related field or equivalent work experience or military experience
Demonstrable experience working as a Cyber Security Analyst or in a similar security-related role
Solid grasp of information security principles, standards and protocols
Solid understanding of network protocols and architectures, as well as system administration on various operating systems
Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, to convey complex technical information to non-technical collaborators
Ability to work patiently and efficiently with people at all levels of the organization in a support and training role while being in adverse conditions and tight deadlines
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation to support three [Location masked] area locations
Ability to lift up to 20 pounds, crouch, and climb ladders and stairs
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with security tools such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, antivirus, and vulnerability scanning solutions
Experience with security risk assessment methodologies and industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CISSP, CEH, or CISA
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail

cond_0094.intro: Are you an experienced and customer-centric Cyber Security professional? Join our team at [Company name masked] as a Cyber Security Analyst. You will be responsible for safeguarding our organization's information systems, networks, and data from cyber threats and probable security breaches. Your expertise will be essential in maintaining a secure environment that aligns with industry best practices and regulatory requirements. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of how security threats emerge and how systems can be protected against them.
cond_0094.responsibilities:
In this role you will:
Monitor network and system logs, security alerts, and other sources of potential threats. Detect and analyze security incidents promptly and coordinate with relevant teams to implement appropriate incident response procedures. Conduct regular assessments of our systems and networks to identify potential weaknesses and security gaps. Collaborate with the IT team to prioritize and address vulnerabilities effectively. Maintain and manage various security tools and technologies, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, antivirus, and encryption systems, to ensure continuous protection against cyber threats. Assist in developing, updating, and implementing security policies, standards, and procedures to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards. Lead security awareness training sessions for employees, educating them about standard processes and potential security risks, to create a security-conscious culture within the organization. Conduct in-depth analysis of security incidents to identify the root cause, extent of impact, and potential remediation strategies to prevent future occurrences. Stay up-to-date with the latest cyber threats, hacking techniques, and security trends. Analyze threat intelligence reports and incorporate relevant findings into the organization's security measures. Collaborate with internal and external auditors to support security audits, assessments, and compliance reviews. Address any identified issues and assist in implementing corrective actions. Generate regular reports on security incidents, threat landscapes, and overall security posture. Present findings to management and provide recommendations for continuous improvement. Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0094.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, a related field or equivalent work experience or military experience
Demonstrable experience working as a Cyber Security Analyst or in a similar security-related role
Solid grasp of information security principles, standards and protocols
Solid understanding of network protocols and architectures, as well as system administration on various operating systems
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, to convey complex technical information to non-technical collaborators
Ability to work patiently and efficiently with people at all levels of the organization in a support and training role while being in adverse conditions and tight deadlines
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation to support three [Location masked] area locations
Ability to lift up to 20 pounds, crouch, and climb ladders and stairs
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with security tools such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, antivirus, and vulnerability scanning solutions
Experience with security risk assessment methodologies and industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CISSP, CEH, or CISA

cond_0153.intro: We are looking for an experienced Cyber Security Analyst to join our team at [Company name masked]. In this role, you will work with colleagues across the organization to help protect information systems, networks, and data from cyber threats and security breaches, while supporting a secure environment that meets industry best practices and regulatory requirements.
cond_0153.responsibilities:
In this role you will:
Work alongside the IT team to monitor network and system logs, security alerts, and other sources of potential threats.
Detect and analyze security incidents promptly and coordinate with relevant teams to carry out appropriate incident response procedures.
Conduct regular assessments of systems and networks to identify potential weaknesses and security gaps, and work with the IT team to prioritize and address them.
Maintain and manage security tools and technologies — including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, antivirus, and encryption systems — to help ensure continuous protection against cyber threats.
Assist in developing, updating, and implementing security policies, standards, and procedures to support compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.
Facilitate security awareness training sessions for employees, helping them understand standard processes and potential security risks, to build a security-conscious culture across the organization.
Work with relevant stakeholders to conduct in-depth analysis of security incidents, identifying root causes, extent of impact, and remediation strategies to prevent future occurrences.
Stay current with the latest cyber threats, hacking techniques, and security trends, and share relevant findings from threat intelligence reports to inform the organization's security measures.
Coordinate with internal and external auditors to support security audits, assessments, and compliance reviews, and assist in implementing corrective actions where needed.
Prepare and share regular reports on security incidents, threat landscapes, and overall security posture, and present findings and recommendations to management.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0153.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, a related field, or equivalent work or military experience
Demonstrable experience working as a Cyber Security Analyst or in a similar security-related role
Solid grasp of information security principles, standards, and protocols
Solid understanding of network protocols and architectures, as well as system administration on various operating systems
Familiarity with security tools such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, antivirus, and vulnerability scanning solutions
Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, to convey complex technical information to non-technical collaborators
Ability to work patiently and efficiently with people at all levels of the organization in a support and training role under adverse conditions and tight deadlines
Preferred Requirements
Experience with security risk assessment methodologies
Industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CISSP, CEH, or CISA
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
Additional details:
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation to support three [Location masked] area locations. Ability to lift up to 20 pounds, crouch, and climb ladders and stairs. Your work will help maintain a secure environment that aligns with industry best practices and regulatory requirements. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with security analysis and incident response.
cond_0203.responsibilities:
Monitor network and system logs, security alerts, and other sources of potential threats.
Detect and analyze security incidents promptly and coordinate with relevant teams to implement appropriate incident response procedures.
Conduct regular assessments of our systems and networks to identify potential weaknesses and security gaps.
Collaborate with the IT team to prioritize and address vulnerabilities effectively.
Maintain and manage various security tools and technologies, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, antivirus, and encryption systems, to ensure continuous protection against cyber threats.
Assist in developing, updating, and implementing security policies, standards, and procedures to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.
Lead security awareness training sessions for employees, educating them about standard processes and potential security risks, to create a security-conscious culture within the organization.
Conduct in-depth analysis of security incidents to identify the root cause, extent of impact, and potential remediation strategies to prevent future occurrences.
Stay up-to-date with the latest cyber threats, hacking techniques, and security trends. Analyze threat intelligence reports and incorporate relevant findings into the organization's security measures.
Collaborate with internal and external auditors to support security audits, assessments, and compliance reviews. Address any identified issues and assist in implementing corrective actions.
Generate regular reports on security incidents, threat landscapes, and overall security posture. Present findings to management and provide recommendations for continuous improvement.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0203.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, a related field, or equivalent work experience or military experience
Demonstrable experience working as a Cyber Security Analyst or in a similar security-related role
Solid grasp of information security principles, standards, and protocols
Solid understanding of network protocols and architectures, as well as system administration on various operating systems
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, to convey complex technical information to non-technical collaborators
Ability to work patiently and efficiently with people at all levels of the organization in a support and training role while being in adverse conditions and tight deadlines
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation to support three [Location masked] area locations
Ability to lift up to 20 pounds, crouch, and climb ladders and stairs
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with security tools such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, antivirus, and vulnerability scanning solutions
Experience with security risk assessment methodologies and industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CISSP, CEH, or CISA
cond_0203.values: We value work that is grounded in fairness, responsibility, and concern for others. We believe organizations do their best work when they keep people and impact in view.

Detect and analyze security incidents promptly and lead coordination with relevant teams to execute appropriate incident response procedures. Lead coordination with internal and external auditors to support security audits, assessments, and compliance reviews. Address identified issues and drive implementation of corrective actions. Generate regular reports on security incidents, threat landscapes, and overall security posture. Present findings to management and deliver recommendations for continuous improvement. cond_0252.intro: We are looking for a Cyber Security Analyst to join our team at [Company name masked]. In this role, you will work alongside colleagues to help safeguard the organization's information systems, networks, and data from cyber threats and security breaches. Your work will support a secure environment that aligns with industry best practices and regulatory requirements.
cond_0252.responsibilities:
Monitor network and system logs, security alerts, and other sources of potential threats.
Detect and analyze security incidents promptly and coordinate with relevant teams to carry out appropriate incident response procedures.
Conduct regular assessments of systems and networks to identify potential weaknesses and security gaps, and work with the IT team to prioritize and address vulnerabilities effectively.
Maintain and manage security tools and technologies, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, antivirus, and encryption systems, to help ensure continuous protection against cyber threats.
Assist in developing, updating, and implementing security policies, standards, and procedures to support compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.
Coordinate security awareness training sessions for employees, helping them understand standard processes and potential security risks, to build a security-conscious culture across the organization.
Conduct in-depth analysis of security incidents together with relevant stakeholders to identify root cause, extent of impact, and potential remediation strategies to prevent future occurrences.
Stay current with the latest cyber threats, hacking techniques, and security trends, and share relevant findings from threat intelligence reports to inform the organization's security measures.
Work alongside internal and external auditors to support security audits, assessments, and compliance reviews, and help implement corrective actions where needed.
Generate regular reports on security incidents, threat landscapes, and overall security posture, and share findings and recommendations with management.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0252.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, a related field or equivalent work experience or military experience
Demonstrable experience working as a Cyber Security Analyst or in a similar security-related role
Solid grasp of information security principles, standards and protocols
Familiarity with security tools such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, antivirus, and vulnerability scanning solutions
Experienced with security risk assessment methodologies and industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CISSP, CEH, or CISA
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
Solid understanding of network protocols and architectures, as well as system administration on various operating systems
Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, to convey complex technical information to non-technical collaborators
Ability to work patiently and efficiently with people at all levels of the organization in a support and training role while being in adverse conditions and tight deadlines
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation to support three [Location masked] area locations
Ability to lift up to 20 pounds, crouch, and climb ladders and stairs

cond_0487.intro: We are looking for an experienced Cyber Security Analyst to join our team at [Company name masked]. In this role you will be responsible for safeguarding the organization's information systems, networks, and data from cyber threats and security breaches, while maintaining a secure environment that aligns with industry best practices and regulatory requirements.
cond_0487.responsibilities:
In this role you will:
Monitor network and system logs, security alerts, and other sources of potential threats. Detect and analyze security incidents promptly and coordinate with relevant teams to implement appropriate incident response procedures. Conduct regular assessments of our systems and networks to identify potential weaknesses and security gaps. Collaborate with the IT team to prioritize and address vulnerabilities effectively. Maintain and manage various security tools and technologies, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, antivirus, and encryption systems, to ensure continuous protection against cyber threats. Assist in developing, updating, and implementing security policies, standards, and procedures to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards. Lead security awareness training sessions for employees, educating them about standard processes and potential security risks, to create a security-conscious culture within the organization. Conduct in-depth analysis of security incidents to identify the root cause, extent of impact, and potential remediation strategies to prevent future occurrences. Stay up-to-date with the latest cyber threats, hacking techniques, and security trends. Analyze threat intelligence reports and incorporate relevant findings into the organization's security measures. Collaborate with internal and external auditors to support security audits, assessments, and compliance reviews. Address any identified issues and assist in implementing corrective actions. Generate regular reports on security incidents, threat landscapes, and overall security posture. Present findings to management and provide recommendations for continuous improvement. Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0487.requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, a related field or equivalent work experience or military experience
Demonstrable experience working as a Cyber Security Analyst or in a similar security-related role
Solid grasp of information security principles, standards and protocols
Solid understanding of network protocols and architectures, as well as system administration on various operating systems
Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, to convey complex technical information to non-technical collaborators
Ability to work patiently and efficiently with people at all levels of the organization in a support and training role while being in adverse conditions and tight deadlines

Experience with security risk assessment methodologies and industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CISSP, CEH, or CISA

cond_0559.intro: We are looking for an experienced Cyber Security Analyst to join our team at [Company name masked]. In this role you will be responsible for safeguarding the organization's information systems, networks, and data from cyber threats and security breaches, while maintaining a secure environment that aligns with industry best practices and regulatory requirements.
cond_0559.responsibilities:
In this role you will:
Monitor network and system logs, security alerts, and other sources of potential threats. Detect and analyze security incidents promptly and coordinate with relevant teams to implement appropriate incident response procedures. Conduct regular assessments of our systems and networks to identify potential weaknesses and security gaps. Collaborate with the IT team to prioritize and address vulnerabilities effectively. Maintain and manage various security tools and technologies, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, antivirus, and encryption systems, to ensure continuous protection against cyber threats. Assist in developing, updating, and implementing security policies, standards, and procedures to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards. Lead security awareness training sessions for employees, educating them about standard processes and potential security risks, to create a security-conscious culture within the organization. Conduct in-depth analysis of security incidents to identify the root cause, extent of impact, and potential remediation strategies to prevent future occurrences. Stay up-to-date with the latest cyber threats, hacking techniques, and security trends. Analyze threat intelligence reports and incorporate relevant findings into the organization's security measures. Collaborate with internal and external auditors to support security audits, assessments, and compliance reviews. Address any identified issues and assist in implementing corrective actions. Generate regular reports on security incidents, threat landscapes, and overall security posture. Present findings to management and provide recommendations for continuous improvement. Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0559.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, a related field or equivalent work experience or military experience
Demonstrable experience working as a Cyber Security Analyst or in a similar security-related role
Solid grasp of information security principles, standards and protocols
Solid understanding of network protocols and architectures, as well as system administration on various operating systems
Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, to convey complex technical information to non-technical collaborators
Ability to work patiently and efficiently with people at all levels of the organization in a support and training role while being in adverse conditions and tight deadlines
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation to support three [Location masked] area locations
Ability to lift up to 20 pounds, crouch, and climb ladders and stairs
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with security tools such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, antivirus, and vulnerability scanning solutions
Experience with security risk assessment methodologies and industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CISSP, CEH, or CISA
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail

cond_0580.intro: Are you an experienced and customer-centric Cyber Security professional? Join our team at [Company name masked] as a Cyber Security Analyst. You will be responsible for safeguarding our organization's information systems, networks, and data from cyber threats and probable security breaches. Your expertise will be essential in maintaining a secure environment that aligns with industry best practices and regulatory requirements. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of how security threats emerge and how systems can be protected against them.
cond_0580.responsibilities:
In this role you will:
Monitor network and system logs, security alerts, and other sources of potential threats. Detect and analyze security incidents promptly and coordinate with relevant teams to implement appropriate incident response procedures. Conduct regular assessments of our systems and networks to identify potential weaknesses and security gaps. Collaborate with the IT team to prioritize and address vulnerabilities effectively. Maintain and manage various security tools and technologies, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, antivirus, and encryption systems, to ensure continuous protection against cyber threats. Assist in developing, updating, and implementing security policies, standards, and procedures to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards. Lead security awareness training sessions for employees, educating them about standard processes and potential security risks, to create a security-conscious culture within the organization. Conduct in-depth analysis of security incidents to identify the root cause, extent of impact, and potential remediation strategies to prevent future occurrences. Stay up-to-date with the latest cyber threats, hacking techniques, and security trends. Analyze threat intelligence reports and incorporate relevant findings into the organization's security measures. Collaborate with internal and external auditors to support security audits, assessments, and compliance reviews. Address any identified issues and assist in implementing corrective actions. Generate regular reports on security incidents, threat landscapes, and overall security posture. Present findings to management and provide recommendations for continuous improvement. Perform other duties as assigned.
